mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a strict sign turn in the completed four-hour slope of the canonical sixteen-period Hull Moving Average marks a low-lag trend rotation; follow the newly signed slope for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when current HMA-minus-prior HMA crosses strictly from negative to positive; short on the strict reverse turn
mechanism.why_distinct: KAMA recursively adapts one exponential smoothing constant from path efficiency, MACD subtracts fixed EMAs, and time-price fit uses OLS. HVHMA forms a fixed weighted half-length/full-length difference and smooths it over the square-root length before testing its slope; it uses no KAMA parameter repair, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour low-lag weighted-average turns are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.weighted_average: for length n, completed closes receive chronological integer weights 1 through n, with the newest weight n
features.hma: WMA(raw_hull,4), all constituent bars finite and source-valid
features.turn: current HMA-minus-immediately-prior HMA strict nonzero sign differs from the immediately prior finite nonzero slope sign
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Hull Moving Average slope turn under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no HMA length, weighting, slope, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Alan Hull canonical Hull Moving Average construction
external_basis.fixed_definition: HMA(16)=WMA(2*WMA(close,8)-WMA(close,16),4), with linearly increasing recent weights; trade strict slope sign turn
external_basis.selection_use: published length-16 half/full/square-root construction and trend-turn interpretation only; no incidence or outcomes
